notes: Budget cap of 30 fetches made the prescribed set (9 queries x 11 networks = 99) impossible, so I ran combined cross-network queries and logged every call, failures included. Reddit returned a login-wall HTML page on all three subs. GitHub rate-limited after 2 queries. Medium returned 403. The first HN batch failed on an unencoded filter. Stack Overflow had nothing in the window: Maestro hits were mostly the Maestro UI-testing framework or pre-2023 card-regex posts, and NYCE/Interlink hits were false matches. HN hits in the window were cardholder or European consumer talk, so out of scope. No critical item surfaced for developer, fintech or program-manager audiences, so the balance rule could not be met. Out-of-scope critical signal worth routing to the merchant/institutional run: Julie Fergerson, CPFPP (LinkedIn, 2023-10-10) on issuers routing PINless card-present debit to Visa/Mastercard rails. Commenters there call on Star, Pulse, NYCE and Accel to push back and note that FIS/Fiserv own both processors and networks. Found but not coded (vendor or network pages with no partner sentiment): Checkout.com PINless docs, Galileo network docs, SHAZAM fintech landing page, FIS CULIANCE page, Chargeblast/Chargeback Gurus explainers. No program-manager voice found for any network. Plus, Cirrus (beyond the BIN file), SHAZAM, CULIANCE, Jeanie and AFFN produced zero partner items. Wayback lookups were not run for budget reasons, so archive_url is null throughout. Excerpts from LinkedIn and TabaPay came through the WebFetch extraction model and should be checked against the source before external use.
